notes.title: Major fix 1.19
notes.content:
[h3]Dear fans of The Dark Pictures, we would like to inform you that [b]version 1.19 for Man Of Medan is now available[/b]. We have been working hard to address all your feedback and [b]would like to sincerely apologise[/b] for any issues encountered while playing the game.[/h3]

Fixing such issues is not always quick or easy, so [b]we thank you for your patience[/b] while we addressed them.

[h3]The patch includes:[/h3]
✔️ Movie Night Infinite loading screen fix
✔️ Multiplayer and logic blocker fixes
✔️ Fixed multiple issues with older save files getting corrupted
✔️ Improved stability and overall game performance
✔️ Fixed several issues with Collectables and Bearings
✔️ Fixed issues with menu text visibility

We are sorry to report that due to the nature of the update, some players’ save games will unfortunately remain corrupted. Players who played the game after the previous update using pre-existing save games are likely to be affected.

[b]Please accept our sincere apologies for this, and for any inconvenience caused.[/b]

[h3]The free PC update for Man of Medan now includes:[/h3]
•	[b]New difficulty settings[/b] & QTE warnings,
•	[b]Improved UI[/b] & interactions,
•	Updated bearing art & event triggers,
•	[b]Increased walking speeds[/b],
•	[b]More accessibility options[/b], including subtitle sizing,
•	[b]Additional Bonus[/b]: discover a previously unseen chapter called  “Flooded”, introducing new gameplay and new deaths to the climatic ending of the game.

Rest assured that we are working on an update for Little Hope and we should have that ready for you very soon.

notes.title: [RESOLVED] Issue affecting the Man of Medan update on Steam
notes.content:
[h3]Dear players, [b]the issue[/b] affecting the Man of Medan update on Steam [b]has been resolved[/b] and [b]patch 1.19 is now available[/b]. Please refer to this page for more details on the fixes: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/939850/view/3653012651432224817]Major Fix 1.19[/url]

We are actively working on a hotfix for Little Hope as well, which will be available very soon.

Thank you for your patience and continued support of the Anthology.[/h3]

notes.title: Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope delayed until autumn
notes.content:
Until Dawn developer Supermassive Games has pushed back the launch of Little Hope, the second game in its Dark Pictures Anthology series.

The horror adventure was set to launch this summer, but will now arrive in the autumn due to complications arising from remote game development while the studio itself remains closed.

"It rests with me to make the unfortunate announcement that Little Hope will be delayed past the summer release already announced, now targeting fall 2020," Supermassive boss Pete Samuels said in a statement posted to the studio's Twitter this afternoon.

notes.title: New Patch is Live!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that a new patch has just been launched focusing on bug fixing and some performance improvements! Along with fixing many of your bug requests, this patch will correct some issues with framerate drops and stutters – plus we’ve also eliminated some game crashes. 

Thank you all again for your patience and help as we fix these issues. Please continue to tell us if you run into other problems on the Ourang Medan – other than murderous pirates, ghosts, and the hazards that come from being trapped on a giant rotting battleship – those are all working as intended!

[h1]All Platforms[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game no longer locks during the “Meetup” chapter when the user must choose between “Jump” and “Run” while playing in Shared Story Mode.
[*] Game no longer crashes if a user is invited to join Shared Story mode while on a “disconnected controller” message screen from within in the “Character and collections” interface.
[*] Replaced missing subtitles for Fliss and Julia during the “Dive” chapter in Shared Story Mode.
[*] Corrected Currator’s dialogue in his third cutscene so it no longer contradicts certain moral choices in Shared Story Mode.
[*] “Return to start” arrow at the end of comic book has been replaced.
[*] Character models no longer overlap on the Relationship/Trait menu during the “The End” chapter when in Movie Night/Solo Story Mode.
[/list]


[b]Removed framerate drop or stutter:[/b]
[list]
[*] When Conrad explains about the duration of the storm in the “Kidnap” chapter.
[*] During cutscenes between gameplay in the “Meetup” chapter.
[*] During cutscenes between gameplay in the “Glamor Girl” chapter.
[*] During the final QTE when Conrad climbs a ladder in the “Glamor Girl” chapter.
[*] While walking through the locker room in the “An Escape” chapter while in Solo Story Mode.
[*] While walking through the engine room in the “An Escape” chapter while in Solo Story Mode.
[*] When entering the first room during the “Distress Signal” chapter.
[*] While walking through the Kitchen in the “Caskets” chapter.
[*] During the QTE “Keep calm” in the “Trapped” chapter.
[/list]

[h1]Steam/PC[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game will no longer lock the invited player’s game if the host plays the Shared Story Mode “Caskets” chapter as Joe.
[*] Game no longer locks if the player fails Julia’s initial stair-climbing QTE in Solo Mode during the “Meetup” chapter.
[*] Game no longer crashes if the player presses “R” during Conrad’s chase scene in the “Glamor Girl” level while playing in either Solo Story or Movie Night mode.
[*] Game no longer refuses keyboard or mouse input after alt-tabbing away from the program while in low resolution and fullscreen mode.
[*] Pictures and Secrets collected during gameplay now correctly update on the Achievements page.
[*] The “View Collectables” screen no longer blocks keyboard input.
[*] Left mouse button is now correctly highlighted when swiping through the pictures from the Divecam.
[*] Pressing “R” during the chase scene in the chapter “Glamor Girl” no longer returns the player to the title screen when in Movie Night/Solo Story Mode.
[/list]

[b]Removed framerate drop or stutter:[/b]
[list]
[*] When entering the Radio room during the chapter “Distress Signal.”
[*] When Brad drops down the gantry in the “Olson” chapter.
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan
notes.content:
The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan is Now Available on Steam!

The Dark Pictures Anthology is a series of stand-alone, branching cinematic horror games that can also be played online with a friend.

In Man of Medan, five friends set sail on a holiday diving trip that soon changes into something much more sinister.
